title: Does Marginal Coverage Guarantee Class-Conditional Safety for Zero-Shot VLMs Under Shift?
abstract: arXiv:2608.19376v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Split-conformal prediction provides marginal coverage under exchangeability and is increasingly used as an abstention layer for zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs). We audit this practice under deployment shift for CLIP, OpenCLIP, and SigLIP across ImageNet and non-ImageNet settings. Marginal coverage can remain relatively high while class-conditional tail coverage collapses: on ImageNet-Sketch, worst-class coverage falls to $\approx 0$ and 10-12% of classes lie below a finite-sample null floor, despite marginal coverage of about 0.86. The failure is aligned with target-domain class accuracy but is not predicted by the source-domain diagnostics we test. Source-side Mondrian calibration improves the in-distribution tail but does not transfer, while clustered conformal and Conf-OT improve marginal or average metrics without recovering the worst-class tail. Target-side class calibration substantially lifts the tail, but requires label

translated_title: 边际覆盖保证能否确保零样本视觉语言模型在分布偏移下的类条件安全性？
translated_abstract: 分割共形预测在可交换性假设下提供边际覆盖，并日益被用作零样本视觉语言模型（VLMs）的弃权层。我们针对CLIP、OpenCLIP和SigLIP在ImageNet及非ImageNet设置下的部署偏移审计了这一实践。边际覆盖可能保持相对较高，而类条件尾部覆盖却崩溃：在ImageNet-Sketch上，最差类覆盖降至约0，10-12%的类别低于有限样本零下限，尽管边际覆盖约为0.86。该失败与目标域类准确率对齐，但无法通过我们测试的源域诊断预测。源侧Mondrian校准改善了分布内尾部，但不能迁移；而聚类共形和Conf-OT改善了边际或平均指标，却未恢复最差类尾部。目标侧类校准显著提升了尾部，但需要标签。
tldr: 本研究揭示零样本视觉语言模型在部署偏移下，边际覆盖可能保持较高，但类条件尾部覆盖会崩溃，且现有诊断和校准方法无法有效预测或修复该问题。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that under deployment shift, marginal coverage for zero-shot VLMs can remain high while class-conditional tail coverage collapses, and existing diagnostics and calibration methods fail to predict or fix this issue.
